metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 G-code simulator in [output](/workspace/output).

Build and run:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build
cmake --build build
./build/simulator --input program.ngc --output result.json
```

The build succeeds, and success/error JSON plus trace output were validated with representative programs.
